rows.title: 'Poor Things' Review: Monster Mash
rows.dek_lead: “Poor Things” is about the humanation of a monster, yet because Lanthimos isn’t interested in less obvious, blander human qualities like gentleness, the movie grows progressively monotonal, flat and dull.
